questions.question: What approach adapts layouts to different screen sizes?
questions.explanation: Responsive design creates layouts that adapt to various devices.

questions.question: Which CSS feature applies styles based on device characteristics?
questions.explanation: Media queries adjust styles based on screen properties.

questions.question: What meta tag controls viewport behavior on mobile?
questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag controls mobile display scaling.

questions.question: What unit is relative to viewport width?
questions.explanation: vw represents a percentage of viewport width.

questions.question: Which layout model simplifies responsive design?
questions.explanation: Flexbox creates flexible, responsive layouts easily.

questions.question: What approach designs for mobile devices first?
questions.explanation: Mobile-first design starts with mobile layouts.

questions.question: Which property makes images scale with containers?
questions.explanation: max-width: 100% makes images responsive.

questions.question: What CSS Grid property creates responsive columns?
questions.explanation: grid-template-columns defines responsive column layouts.

questions.question: Which breakpoint typically targets tablets?
questions.explanation: 768px commonly targets tablet devices.

questions.question: What CSS function adjusts values between breakpoints?
questions.explanation: clamp sets responsive min, ideal, and max values.

questions.question: When do styles inside @media (max-width: 768px) take effect?
options: When the viewport is wider than 768px
When the viewport is 768px wide or narrower
questions.explanation: max-width applies styles at or below the given width.

questions.question: Which viewport meta value matches page width to the device screen?
questions.explanation: width=device-width sets the layout width to the device width.

questions.question: Which unit sizes an element relative to its parent's font size?
questions.explanation: em units scale relative to the parent font size.

questions.question: Which Flexbox property distributes items along the main axis?
questions.explanation: justify-content controls main-axis spacing.

questions.question: Which Flexbox property aligns items along the cross axis?
questions.explanation: align-items positions items on the cross axis.

questions.question: Which CSS Grid unit represents a fraction of available space?
questions.explanation: The fr unit divides remaining grid space into fractions.

questions.question: What responsive approach sizes layouts with percentages instead of fixed pixels?
questions.explanation: Fluid layouts stretch proportionally with the viewport.

questions.question: Which media feature detects a user's dark theme preference?
questions.explanation: prefers-color-scheme detects light or dark mode.

questions.question: A shop's product grid must switch from four columns on desktop to one column on phones. Which technique applies different styles at breakpoints?
questions.explanation: Media queries swap layout rules at defined breakpoints.

questions.question: What icon of three stacked lines commonly opens a collapsed mobile menu?
questions.explanation: The hamburger icon hides navigation on small screens.

questions.question: Which Chrome DevTools feature simulates different device screen sizes?
questions.explanation: Device Mode emulates viewports, zoom, and touch input.

questions.question: What minimum touch target size does Google recommend for mobile elements?
questions.explanation: Google recommends at least 48x48px touch targets.

questions.question: What design approach detects devices server-side and serves different layouts?
questions.explanation: Adaptive design serves device-specific templates.

questions.question: Which viewport directive controls whether users can pinch to zoom?
questions.explanation: user-scalable=no disables pinch zooming.

questions.question: Which CSS media type targets styles for printed output?
questions.explanation: The print media type applies styles to printed pages.

questions.question: Which property sets spacing between flex or grid items without margins?
questions.explanation: gap defines row and column spacing in flex and grid layouts.

questions.question: A store site renders zoomed-out and tiny on phones until the developer adds which tag?
questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag matches layout width to device width; without it phones render a ~980px desktop page.

questions.question: A product photo serves high resolution on retina screens but a lightweight file on phones, with the browser picking the candidate. Which attribute enables this?
questions.explanation: srcset lists candidate files with descriptors so the browser selects the optimal source.

questions.question: The same product image must show a wide crop on desktop but a square crop on mobile. Which element enables per-breakpoint image swapping?
questions.explanation: <picture> lets <source> elements art-direct different crops per media condition.

questions.question: Which media query detects that the primary input mechanism cannot hover?
questions.explanation: (hover: none) matches devices whose primary input lacks hover capability, typical of touchscreens.

questions.question: A dashboard uses `grid-template-columns: 1fr 3fr` so tracks resize proportionally at any width. Which layout strategy is this?
questions.explanation: Fluid layouts use proportional units like fr and percentages; adaptive layouts snap at fixed breakpoints.
